title: TS-42 Deploy workflow and ECS start wiring for ChatticusControlPlane
description:
## Goal
Make the dormant ChatticusControlPlane stack deployable to development by the same CI path as the other stacks, and wire the ComputerStarter to ECS, so TS-39 (rehearsal) has a deployed stack to run against. Found while preparing TS-39: TS-36 built the stack but nothing deploys it and the starter has no ECS wiring.

## Files
- infra/deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh: add `development:control-plane` -> `ChatticusControlPlane` (development only; staging and production are added by TS-40), update the usage text.
- .github/workflows/deploy-controlplane-development.yml: copy the shape of .github/workflows/deploy-thinturn-development.yml (push to develop, workflow_dispatch, OIDC role, environment development) and run `sh deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh development control-plane`.
- infra/lib/control-plane-stack.ts and infra/test/control-plane-stack.test.ts: wire the ComputerStarter Lambda to ECS host start exactly as infra/lib/thin-turn-stack.ts does with `computerHostStartEcsConfig` in infra/lib/computer-host-start.ts (env vars CHATTICUS_HOST_STARTER=ecs and the ECS settings, the ecs:RunTask, iam:PassRole and related permissions); when the config is absent the starter keeps the no-op env. Also confirm in the stack and test that the executor and probe Lambdas carry CHATTICUS_COMPUTER_STARTS_QUEUE_URL and CHATTICUS_ENVIRONMENT, and fix if not.
- infra/lib/github-deploy-stack.ts (only if the OIDC deploy role cannot deploy a stack named ChatticusControlPlane; read it and say so in the report).

## Rules
No `cdk deploy`, no AWS writes, no IAM users or access keys. Tests: infra npm test with new assertions, a mutation check on at least one new assertion, and a real `cdk synth` is NOT possible locally (Python lambda bundling fails on this machine); say so and rely on CI. Does the deploy script also need the ECS context the thin-turn script computes? Read how thin-turn gets it in CI (deploy-chatticus-dedicated-account.sh does not pass it) and mirror that, no more.
right_now_summary: The deployment workflow and ECS start wiring for ChatticusControlPlane still need to be added and tested.
